_comment: Lights (rdLight.c and the set's lights, 2026-11-14): the renderer's light (rdLight, 0x3c bytes: rdLight_NewEntry sets its defaults, rdLight_SetAngles its spot cone) and the set's named light (SetLight, 0x68 bytes: the array at set+0xbc, its count at set+0xb8; sputRoom_GetLight / sputRoom_FindLightByName), which the Lua light API (sputLua_*Light*) and the light editor work on.

structs.name: rdLight
structs.comment: A light of the renderer (0x3c bytes).
fields: 1 ambient .. 3 spot (2 by default, rdLight_NewEntry; SetLightType)
spot cone, degrees (rdLight_SetAngles' inner, the Lua umbra)
spot cone outer angle (the Lua penumbra)
1 / (cos inner - cos outer), set only when that is positive

structs.name: SetLight
structs.comment: A named light of a set (0x68 bytes, the array at set+0xbc).
